title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
title_zh: Urbex：面向城市级三维场景的智能体空间定位

paragraphs.en: Urbex 是一个基于智能体的视觉-语言框架，用于城市级三维场景的定位。 City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.
paragraphs.zh: Urbex 是一种基于智能体的视觉-语言框架，用于城市级三维场景的定位。城市级三维定位通常被表述为候选项排序问题，这需要预先计算实例提案，因此在大型户外场景中效率低下。 我们提出了 Urbex，这是一种智能体驱动的视觉-语言框架，它将定位问题转化为主动的空间搜索。 Urbex 将城市级三维场景表示为一个交互式多视角环境，使视觉-语言模型智能体能够查询地标、放大局部区域、渲染斜角视图并确定一个定位后的边界框。 我们在 CityRefer 数据集上通过强化学习优化了这一工具使用策略，利用平滑的定位奖励和轻量化的引导奖励来实现高效探索。 实验表明，Urbex 在 CityRefer 数据集上取得了最高的 Hit@1 和 IoU 值，支持无需候选项和真实标注框的定位，并且比最强的城市级排序基线方法快得多。 在 STPLS3D-Refer 上的零样本结果进一步表明，该框架在跨场景的鲁棒性方面得到了提升。
